notes.title: Bara Giants Major Update #1
notes.content:
We’re so excited to start our major updates for Bara Giants and Yes, Brother saga!

As you may have read in our announcement post, Bara Giants' endings would be changed when the Halloween Sale 2021 started (you can read the full post here) and this update is now available.

We hope you enjoy it and feel free to report any bugs by joining Discord or using the game forum.

Thank you all for supporting us and we hope you enjoy our upcoming releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704310/Burning_Horns_A_Bara_Isekai_JRPG/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/Magic_Exposure__Yuri_Visual_Novel/

Don’t forget to follow our Steam page, we’re getting closer to 600 followers!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.content:
We've made a few adjustments, so check out what has changed:


✔️ 2 items have been added: a Treasures Counter and a Mirror Counter. Both will help you to check your progress to complete the Treasure Hunters achievements and the Dreamy Vision one. You can get them at the Library.
✔️ Mirrors have been rebalanced: now they will recover 20% of the party HP and give you 5 LP instead of 25%/20 LP.
✔️ Minor bugs have been fixed too.

Feel free to join Discord to report any bug you found.

Male Doll Team
